_why: Shadow is the one spec in this pass where the BUILD is the deliverable and
the rotation is secondary: the Shadow tree itself is barely touched -- Shadow
Affinity is its only modified talent -- and the redesign lives in Discipline
tiers 0-3.
Killing Word 3/3    (Disc T1.0, was Silent Resolve) Shadow Word: Death
deals more damage for each periodic effect on the
target. Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague and
Vampiric Touch are all already maintained, so this is
a standing multiplier on the execute.
Gnosticism 2/2      (Disc T3.3, was Improved Mana Burn) shadow damage
restores mana. The sustain half.
Shadow Affinity 3/3 (Shadow T1.0) the tree's own redesigned talent:
threat and dispel removed, now increases healing and
restores mana.
SOUL WARDING IS DELIBERATELY NOT BOUGHT, and this is the whole shape of the
build. It removes Shadow Word: Death's backlash only while Power Word:
Shield holds -- and Power Word: Shield is a Holy spell, so casting it drops
Shadowform. A Shadowform priest would be trading 15% shadow damage and
Improved Shadowform's mitigation for a shield every cycle. The two cannot be
combined, and Shadowform wins, so the three points go back into Shadow as
Mind Melt 2/2 and the second point of Improved Shadow Word: Pain.
The Discipline dip is 17 rather than 13 because Gnosticism sits at tier 3 and
needs 15 points above it; it runs 5 / 12 / 15 / 17 by tier against gates of
0 / 5 / 10 / 15, so it reaches with nothing to spare.
Shadow gives up range and cooldown utility rather than throughput: Veiled
Shadows 2/2 (Shadowfiend and Fade cooldowns), Shadow Reach 2/2, Improved
Spirit Tap 2/2 and one point of Spirit Tap. Improved Mind Blast stays 5/5 --
Focused Will has Mind Blast refresh Devouring Plague, which feeds Killing
Word's count, so it is upkeep as well as damage.
54 Shadow / 17 Discipline.
